# Sirach Chapter 35 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_035_page_001.jpg

---

35:1 Keeping the law is worth many offerings; observing the commandments is like sacrificing a peace offering.

35:2 Returning a kindness is like presenting an offering of fine flour; giving to charity is like offering a thank offering.

35:3 To refrain from wickedness is pleasing to the Lord, and to abstain from injustice is a means of atonement.

35:4 Do not come before the Lord empty-handed, for all such things are commanded to be done.

35:5 The offering of the righteous person enriches the altar, and its pleasing aroma rises before the Most High.

35:6 The sacrifice of a righteous person is acceptable, and its memorial will never be forgotten.

35:7 Honor the Lord with generosity, and do not reduce the firstfruits of your hands.

35:8 With every offering, show a cheerful face, and dedicate your tithe with joy.

35:9 Give to the Most High as he has given you — generously, and according to your means.

35:10 For the Lord is one who repays, and he will repay you seven times over.

35:11 Do not try to bribe him, for he will not accept it; and do not put confidence in an ill-gotten sacrifice; for the Lord is the judge, and with him there is no favoritism.

35:12 He does not show partiality against the poor, and he hears the prayer of the one who is mistreated.

35:13 He does not disregard the petition of the orphan, nor the widow when she pours out her complaint.

35:14 Do not the widow's tears run down her cheek, and is not her cry against whoever caused them to fall?

35:15 Whoever serves God wholeheartedly will be accepted, and that one's prayer will reach to the clouds.

35:16 The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds, and it will not rest until it reaches its destination; it will not withdraw until the Most High responds

35:17 and does right by the righteous and carries out judgment. Indeed, the Lord will not delay, nor will he be patient with them,

35:18 until he breaks the loins of the merciless and repays the nations with vengeance; until he eliminates the multitude of the arrogant and breaks the scepters of the unrighteous;

35:19 until he pays every person back according to what they have done, and repays human deeds according to their intentions; until he vindicates his people and gladdens them with his mercy.

35:20 Mercy is as welcome in a time of distress as rain clouds during a drought.
